[{"insert":"Back Squat

The back squat alternates with the 1 1/4 cyclist version across this cycle. Without the heel elevation, the demand shifts toward the posterior chain and asks for more hip and ankle mobility to hold depth. This is a volume block, so the reps build from Week 2 rather than drop, adding total work each time it returns. Keep the depth and speed honest from the first rep to the last.
"}]
